newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK DEPUTY FINMIN TO HOLD PRESSER ON PUBLIC DEBT.
newsitem.headline: GREEK DEPUTY FINMIN TO HOLD PRESSER ON PUBLIC DEBT.

text.p: Greek Deputy Finance Minister Nickos Christodoulakis will hold a press conference on Monday at 1300 local on public debt, a press official at the finance ministry told Reuters.
Christodoulakis is expected to talk about public debt management and the restructuring of the Greek treasury.
Greece has a new seven-member public debt management committee headed by Christodoulakis, officials said.

Bank of Greece Deputy Governor Takis Thomopoulos, the prime minister's Economic Advisor Tassos Yanitsis, chairman of economic advisors at the national economy ministry Yannis Stournaras, finance ministry general secretary Yannis Kousoulakos, public debt management expert Christopher Sardelis and finance ministry official Dimitris Dritsas also participate in the committee. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
